title: JustSink
description: Just added a useful sink to Minecraft.
body:
### Just adds a simple and beautiful sink to Minecraft.  
You can use fluid containers or pipes to draw infinite water from it, or use it as a kitchen sink for draining waste fluids.  
Supports fluid containers and fluid pipes from most mods.
![the pipes with sink](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7f65beefe1300760159ede71a31774f54a342850.jpeg)
